name: James Wishart
role: Freighter on the Black Hills routes
bio: James 'Jim' Wishart was an old-time freighter whose outfit hauled freight through Medora in 1884 and brought Rassie Deffebach's family and goods to town that August. In November 1885 the paper reported the death in Deadwood of his wife, who drove a string team alongside him.

moments.label: Wife, also a teamster, died in Deadwood
